description: Derived from AGSC-08-17: the clean-room lint MUST refuse, as AGSC-E405, a reference to a numbered division of a work anywhere in authored prose: the case-folded word chapter or chapters followed by whitespace and decimal digits or a Roman numeral, refused as a pattern and never as a literal list of numbers. Three concepts are added to the minimal fixture, each conforming in every key and a member of its cluster. roman.md writes the plural in capitals followed by a Roman numeral, which case folding and the Roman alternative both catch: one error. tabbed.md writes the singular, a tab and decimal digits, which the whitespace of the rule catches: one error. plain.md uses the word with no numeral after it: nothing. The whole list `lint` reports is the two AGSC-E405 errors, and lint exits 1. The clean-room lint is one of the four lints AGSC-10-04 places at Level 3, which is why the case sits in this area.
